# Mount N Muscle

> Owner-operated home services across the Charlotte, NC metro — junk removal, moving, hauling, TV mounting, flooring, and handyman work. Published rates, free quotes, same-day response.

## Contact
- Phone / text: 704-237-0164
- Website: https://mountnmuscle.com
- Base: Steele Creek, Charlotte, NC 28278
- Hours: Mon–Sat 8am–8pm, Sun 10am–6pm
- Google listing: https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id:ChIJgRo4_MQfVIgRZNFDv-ZQRog

## Pricing
- Junk removal: priced by space in a 16ft trailer — single item $95, 1/8 $150, 1/4 $235, 3/8 $315, 1/2 $395, 5/8 $475, 3/4 $560, full $700. Surcharges: mattress +$25, refrigerant appliance +$40, tire +$8.
- TV mounting (flat): up to 55" $99 · 56–75" $149 · over-fireplace/stone from $199 · additional TV same visit $79. Add-ons: stick-on cord conceal $39, in-wall from $89, flat mount $40, full-motion mount $65.
- Labor: solo/handyman $70/hr ($140 min) · two-person crew $135/hr ($270 min). Two-hour minimum, 30-minute increments after.
- Trailer add-on (added to any crew rate): utility trailer 5x8 or 6x10 +$25/hr · 16ft enclosed +$60/hr. Examples: solo + utility = $95/hr; two-person crew + 16ft enclosed = $195/hr. Small hauls can go solo + utility to keep costs down.
- Flooring: LVP/laminate $2.50/sq ft · herringbone/premium $3.50/sq ft · tear-out $0.50/sq ft · subfloor prep $70/hr. Minimum 200 sq ft or $500.
- Travel: Zone 1 no fee (Charlotte S/SW, Steele Creek, Pineville, Lake Wylie, Tega Cay) · Zone 2 +$29 (Fort Mill, Ballantyne, Mount Holly, central Charlotte) · Zone 3 +$49 (Rock Hill, Gastonia, Matthews, Stallings, Indian Trail, Waxhaw, Huntersville) · Zone 4 +$89 (Concord, Mooresville). Hauling adds $3.00/loaded mile beyond the first 10.
- Add-ons: stairs +$25/flight above the first · heavy/awkward item from +$40 · same-day/emergency +$40 · Sunday +15%.

## Referrals
Friends & Neighbors referral credit — $25 credit to whoever refers, and $25 off the new customer's first booking. Anyone counts: friends, neighbors, family, coworkers. Three booked referrals earns $100 credit or a free hour of solo labor. Property managers and realtor teams get custom account rates.
